messages:
Maya (Revenue Ops): Heads-up: customer 'WellHealth Labs' flagged their private deployment renewal invoice INV-2026-0824. They say platform fee proration and midterm support upgrade didn't get billed. attaching screenshot.
Kai (Finance): Can you paste the invoice lines? I don't have access to the attachment from phone.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Pasted:
```
INV-2026-0824
1) Private License Annual - $95,000
2) Platform Fee - $19,000
3) Support: Premium - $0
```
Customer claims they upgraded from Standard to Premium on 2026-03-03 and should owe prorated delta to renewal date 2026-09-15.
Olga (Acct Exec): I approved that upgrade. Deal note: OLGA-plt-upg-03mar, customer accepted additional prorated billing. We should have created a midterm charge.
InvoiceBot: invoice_generated: INV-2026-0824 by system; related_charge_requests: [cr_ef4a]; cr_ef4a status: not_invoiced
Riley (Customer Success): Customer submitted payment for the posted invoice and needs either a credit memo or corrected invoice for their AP team to close the month. They marked it "urgent for audit".
Kai (Finance): Quick math: annual support delta = $10,000, upgrade duration = 195 days (Mar 3 to Sep 15) of 365 -> prorate = 195/365*10k ~= $5,342. Asking to confirm exact calc and whether we billed tax.
Nina (Legal): Contract amendment signed 2026-03-01 confirms the upgrade effective 2026-03-03. Clause 4.2: Customer owes prorated amounts. No contractual issue with issuing credit.
Oliver (Controller): Policy: credits under $10k can be processed by Finance; >=$10k need Controller sign-off. This is ~5.3k so ok. Please include reference to amendment and original invoice.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Customer specifically requests the credit be posted as a negative line item on a reissued invoice rather than a separate credit memo. Any preference?
Kai (Finance): For our AR system it's easier to post a credit memo that references original invoice. We can also export an accounting-friendly PDF that shows the credit as a line for customer reconciliation. That should satisfy them.
Olga (Acct Exec): Customer will accept a credit memo as long as the PDF clearly shows the prorate calculation and amendment ID.
InvoiceBot: billing_ticket=BT-6598 created, status=awaiting_processing
Kai (Finance): Action plan: (1) I'll compute exact prorate including day count and any applicable VAT (Kai) (2) Maya to attach amendment and payment confirmation (Maya) (3) Nina to confirm legal blurb to include (Nina) (4) Once computed I'll issue credit memo and tag Oliver for records (Kai/Oliver). ETA 24 hours.
Riley (Customer Success): I'll let the customer know we will post a credit memo with the detailed calc and get back ASAP. They appreciate speed.
Maya (Revenue Ops): Adding note: customer requested credit applied to next invoice; they prefer netting but will accept separate credit if necessary.
Oliver (Controller): Please make sure GL impact is code 4.2.1 (platform revenue adjustments) and include memo reason code 'midterm_support_upgrade_prorate'.
Kai (Finance): Will do. I'll post update in this thread when credit is posted.
InvoiceBot: ticket_update: BT-6598 status=awaiting_approval; approver=Oliver
Maya (Revenue Ops): thanks everyone, will follow up once we have confirmation from accounting.
